questions.q: Did you use a dictionary ___ the letter?
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — to translate.

questions.q: Your case is so unique that I am not getting any ___ to support it.
questions.e:
Correct answer: D — precedent.
A precedent is an earlier case, decision or example that can be used to support an argument. The sentence says the case is unique and lacks a comparable earlier example. The official final key marks option D.

questions.q: We thought that the Sadhu had miraculous powers but we soon found out that we were ___.
questions.e:
Correct answer: D — deceived.

questions.q: Maria always wears ___ clothes.
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — decent.
“Decent clothes” means clothes that are respectable or appropriate. “Descent” is a noun referring to movement downwards or ancestry, “descend” is a verb, and “dissent” means disagreement. The official key marks C.

questions.q: Specific gravity is defined as the ratio of the density of
o: a substance to the density of hydrogen
a substance to the density of water
water to the density of a substance
mercury to the density of a substance
questions.e:
Correct answer: B — a substance to the density of water.
Specific gravity is the ratio of the density of a substance to the density of a reference substance, conventionally water for many solids and liquids. It is dimensionless because it is a ratio of two densities. The official key marks B.

questions.q: A balloon filled with hydrogen will
o: reach a particular height and keep floating
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — burst after reaching some height.
As the balloon rises, atmospheric pressure decreases and the hydrogen expands. If the balloon's envelope cannot expand further, it bursts. This is the option selected by the MPSC final answer key.

questions.q: Two glass plates with little water in between cannot be separated easily because of
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — surface tension.
A thin water film between the plates produces surface-tension forces at the contact interface. These forces help hold the plates together and make separation difficult. The official final answer key marks option C.

questions.q: The aneroid barometer uses
questions.e:
Correct answer: D — Does not use any liquid.
An aneroid barometer measures atmospheric pressure using a sealed, flexible metal chamber whose small movements are mechanically indicated. Unlike a mercury barometer, it does not rely on a liquid column. The official key marks D.

questions.q: An area of low precipitation on the leeward side of hills/mountain ranges is called
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — rain shadow zone.
Moist air rises on the windward side of a mountain, cools and releases precipitation. Descending air on the leeward side is drier, creating a rain shadow. The official key marks C.

questions.q: The percentages of the areas of oceans and continents on the earth are respectively.

Correct answer: B — 71 and 29.

questions.q: Spot the odd item amongst the following.
questions.e:
Correct answer: B — Brass.

questions.q: Lines connecting the points of equal salinity are called
questions.e:
Correct answer: C — isohalines.
An isohaline is a line on a map joining places with equal salinity. Isoseismals relate to earthquake intensity, isogons to equal magnetic declination, and isohyets to equal rainfall. The official key marks C.

questions.e:
Correct answer: C — southwest coast of Africa.
